//instructions: project's .claude/settings.json. Adjust the absolute path to emit_event.py.
The hook only FORWARDS the raw PostToolUse JSON to the daemon over a Unix
socket; the daemon (daemon/server.py) normalizes it and owns the set of
already-seen paths that decides A (added) vs M (modified) for Write. That is
why there is no PreToolUse hook here: existence is tracked in the daemon, so
the first Write to a path is an add and any later Write is a modify, with no
filesystem probing on the hot path.
